application: One-time source import; the build compiles these checked-in source files directly.

changes.name: max-submodels-512
changes.reason: e1dt1 has 305 models and e4m5a 300; the temporary box and capsule handles stay the last two numbers

changes.name: load-submodels-below-reserved-handles
changes.reason: CM_ClipHandleToModel returns a submodel before it tests for the box handle (cm_load.c:682-686), so a map may not own a reserved handle

changes.name: cgame-inline-models-within-max-models
changes.reason: module code, not engine: with max-submodels-512 a map has up to 510 inline models, and the stock cgame filled its MAX_MODELS (256) inline model arrays up to trap_CM_NumInlineModels() (cg_main.c:1034-1045); the fix is never in q_shared.h or msg.c

changes.name: entity-ext-qcommon
changes.reason: the extension's opcode after the stock ones, its version, the userinfo key, the extension state struct and the two codec prototypes; the capability entity-ext-1 names the whole extension

changes.name: entity-ext-msg-delta
changes.reason: the extension field table and the two codec functions, which call the untouched stock MSG_WriteDeltaEntity / MSG_ReadDeltaEntity and append or read one block per entity

changes.name: entity-ext-server-state
changes.reason: where the engine keeps the game module's extension array beside its gentities

changes.name: entity-ext-server-client-flag
changes.reason: the per-client latch every extended server path tests

changes.name: entity-ext-server-snapshot-ring
changes.reason: the extension ring parallel to the snapshot entity ring, at the same index

changes.name: entity-ext-server-prototypes
changes.reason: sv_snapshot.c reads the rows sv_game.c located

changes.name: entity-ext-server-ring-alloc
changes.reason: the extension ring is allocated with the snapshot entity ring, the same count, zeroed by the hunk

changes.name: entity-ext-server-cvar
changes.reason: the server states that it offers the extension; read-only and never in the serverinfo string, which is the one byte-level difference a stock client could observe

changes.name: entity-ext-server-connect-latch
changes.reason: the negotiation: exactly once per connection, from the connect packet's userinfo, on an exact version match

changes.name: entity-ext-server-gamestate
changes.reason: a negotiated client gets the marker and no baselines, so the gamestate no longer grows with num_edicts (the three large maps); a stock client gets the stock loop, verbatim

changes.name: entity-ext-server-locate
changes.reason: the module hands the engine its extension rows once (SV_LocateEntityExt, refusing another struct size) and the snapshot builder reads a row per entity (SV_EntityExt, a zero row for a stock module)

changes.name: entity-ext-server-locate-case
changes.reason: the trap dispatch of G_DKQ3_LOCATE_ENTITY_EXT

changes.name: entity-ext-game-import-enum
changes.reason: the game module's trap to hand the engine its extension rows, numbered after the stock values (582)

changes.name: entity-ext-game-syscall
changes.reason: module code, like the cgame row of Step 61: the native game module's wrapper of the new trap

changes.name: entity-ext-server-snapshot-copy
changes.reason: each snapshot entity's extension row is copied beside its state, at the same ring index

changes.name: entity-ext-server-emit
changes.reason: the extended packet-entity writer: the stock walk with MSG_WriteDeltaEntityDkq3 and new entities from zero instead of from the baselines the client never received

changes.name: entity-ext-server-snapflag
changes.reason: every extended snapshot says so in a free snapFlags bit, because the server sends snapshots to a CS_CONNECTED client before its gamestate and the client's parser must not depend on which arrives first

changes.name: entity-ext-server-emit-call
changes.reason: the switch between the two writers on the per-client latch

changes.name: entity-ext-client-flag
changes.reason: the per-session latch every extended client path tests

changes.name: entity-ext-client-ring
changes.reason: the extension ring parallel to parseEntities, at the same index, zeroed with cl by CL_ClearState

changes.name: entity-ext-client-svc-name
changes.reason: svc_strings mirrors the enum, as its comment asks

changes.name: entity-ext-client-gamestate-reset
changes.reason: a gamestate without the marker (a stock server, a stock demo) puts the client on the stock parser

changes.name: entity-ext-client-gamestate-marker
changes.reason: the marker raises the latch and prints the negotiated line; a version other than this client's is an error, reachable only from a demo of another version

changes.name: entity-ext-client-delta
changes.reason: the extended reader per packet entity, keyed on the snapshot's own DKQ3_SNAPFLAG_EXT, with the old extension found beside the old state in the ring, and the copy of the old extension on the unchanged path

changes.name: entity-ext-client-cvar
changes.reason: the userinfo key the negotiation reads, beside rate; a stock server ignores keys it does not know; an archived value of an older version is raised to this one, so an upgrade never falls back to the stock stream unasked

changes.name: entity-ext-client-demo-marker
changes.reason: a demo of an extended session carries the marker, so it replays on an extended client and stops a stock one at its gamestate with bad command byte

changes.name: entity-ext-cgame-trap
changes.reason: the cgame's read of a snapshot's extension rows, in CL_GetSnapshot's order, -1 on a stock session

changes.name: entity-ext-cgame-trap-case
changes.reason: the trap dispatch of CG_DKQ3_GET_SNAPSHOT_EXT

changes.name: entity-ext-cgame-import-enum
changes.reason: the cgame's trap to read a snapshot's extension rows, numbered after the stock values (112)

changes.name: entity-ext-cgame-syscall-asm
changes.reason: module code: the QVM syscall number of the new cgame trap, -(112 + 1), so the slice cgame QVM resolves the symbol

changes.name: renderer-follows-the-drawable-size
changes.reason: the renderer must draw at the size the window system gave it: a fullscreen window whose mode the desktop refuses keeps the desktop's drawable, and the image lands in a corner of it (BUG-menu-video-resolution-and-border.md)

changes.name: sound-update-cgame-trap-case
changes.reason: the loading screen's per-block click is started while CG_INIT blocks the main loop, so nothing paints it until the level appears; this trap paints the mix where Gold paints it

changes.name: sound-update-cgame-import-enum
changes.reason: the cgame's trap to paint the sound mix, numbered after the stock values and after the entity extension's

changes.name: sound-update-cgame-syscall-asm
changes.reason: module code: the QVM syscall number of the new cgame trap, so the slice cgame QVM resolves the symbol

changes.name: ext-capabilities-cvar
changes.reason: capability discovery: modules query ext_capabilities with the stock trap_Cvar_VariableStringBuffer
